messages:
morgan: heads up — aps2a-rack11-gpu03 went unresponsive and then started spitting correctable ECC spikes. kdump captured, node unreachable via ssh.
infra-bot: ALERT aps2a-rack11-gpu03 SEV2 | correctable_ecc_rate=124/s | last_seen=1978901200 | auto-drain-triggered=false
alex: which jobs were on that node? can we confirm if any long-running inference batches got killed?
morgan: batch-queue shows 3 active jobs (ml-training) and a handful of small inference containers. I marked it for immediate drain but kube evict hung — kubelet complaining about dmesg OOM logs.
sasha: I'm starting a manual drain now: `kubectl drain aps2a-rack11-gpu03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will force-evict after 30s if pods don't exit cleanly.
ravi: routing note — I'll shift traffic from aps2a to ap-sg and eu-west for the next 45m. Setting capacity weights: ap-sg +10%, eu-west +5%. Will open a quick rollback if cost blows up.
morgan: dropping the kdump snippet here: ```
[  112.345678] NVRAM ECC corrected at 0x7ffabcd1234
[  112.345683] GPU0: correctable ECC error threshold exceeded
[  112.346000] nvidia: GPU panic, halt seq 0x1b
```
alex: thanks. can you post node serial? need to check warranty/RMA history before we schedule on-site swap.
morgan: serial: SN-APS2A-11-GPU03, last rma 2023-04 (fan replaced). RMA queue currently has a 48h window. I'll request expedited RMA and ask parts to stage a spare GPU.
yana: FYI — Dedicated customers on that rack may see degraded p99 latency for a few routes. I'll update status page and bump support to priority if it crosses SLA thresholds.
sasha: drain is complete, all pods evicted or rescheduled except 1 stateful job that failed to checkpoint. tagging owner @ml-team for recovery.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: rolling fallback to model-variant-small in ap-sg started (policy: latency<200ms) — traffic shifted 9% to ap-sg, 5% to eu-west.
morgan: I'm capturing NVME dmesg and smi output, pushing to /tmp/aps2a-rack11-gpu03-kdump.log and to the incident room. attaching links now.
ravi: cost note — shift will add ~$180/hr in spot + burst premiums if we stay above baseline. we should aim to reclaim capacity in 2h or roll to dedicated spare pool to avoid sustained premium.
alex: I'm checking cluster allocation history. If the GPU has repeated ECC correctables, prefer part swap vs reflash. Also verify BMC logs for out-of-band flashes.
morgan: BMC log has a firmware flash event 2 weeks ago from svc-ops. I'll open an ops-ticket to correlate. For now, I've marked node as quarantined in the scheduler and set `drain_reason: hw_ecc_spike`.
yana: publishing status: "Partial capacity degradation in aps2a — some Dedicated customers may experience higher latency. We're routing traffic and provisioning spares. ETA for hardware replace ~6-48h depending on RMA." :warning:
ravi: confirm: do we want to engage fallback model routing permanently until node replaced? could reduce p99 but increases token cost.
sasha: leave a canary fallback for next 30m, monitor p95/p99, then decide. I'll set an alert to notify this thread if p99 > 350ms.
morgan: RMA expedited request submitted (ticket# 45291). parts team acknowledged; on-site window earliest 12h. I'll post updates here when tech confirms swap time.
infra-bot: NOTE incident-state=investigating | node=aps2a-rack11-gpu03 | action=quarantined | ticket=45291
alex: once RMA occurs, let's run full kernel + nv-firmware healthcheck before returning to rotation. Also plan a quick soak in spare pool for 2 hours.
morgan: agreed. I'll coordinate soak and rejoin steps. closing loop: emergency fallback engaged, node quarantined, RMA in progress. will update thread with swap ETA and post-mortem steps. :thumbsup:
